reason: Verification done directly on the A2 Bruhat graph in the manifest convention: W = S3 with the six elements, C_1 = M(s1 dot lambda) + M(s2 dot lambda), C_2 = M(s1s2 dot lambda) + M(s2s1 dot lambda), C_3 = M(w0 dot lambda); all rank-two intervals are diamonds (lem-bruhat-rank-two-intervals-are-diamonds) so d^2 = 0 holds via the square condition (prop-the-bgg-differential-squares-to-zero), and exactness is thm-bgg-resolution-of-a-finite-dimensional-simple-module. Sources: Zhou Sec. 3.2, 4.1 pp. 11, 14; Hemelsoet-Voorhaar Sec. 2.2 pp. 4-6. All deps examined and published.
